Baron Sybaestan Braunpyke is an Arathi located in Morgaen's Tears in Hallowfall. After Aelric Leid's attack on the Veneration Grounds, Sybaestan and his brother Theleon worked to remove the lingering kobyss plaguing the area when they were joined by an outsider sent by General Steelstrike. Together, they killed many kobyss and stole their staves to stop their necromancy. However, Theleon fell in battle when they went to kill the kobyss leading the attacks. Sybaestan brought his brother's body to the Priory of the Sacred Flame so Sister Etna Blayze could perform his funeral. While burning the memories of his brother, the Baron remained inconsolable and wandered off. Prioress Haelsey Murrpray

The Battle.net Authenticator is a two-factor authentication option that adds an additional security step for a Battle.net account. It can be used alongside the Battle.net Phone Notifications which provides benefits for an account. To setup an authenticator for a Battle.net account, one will need to use the Battle.net mobile app to set it up. Previously, the authenticator was offered as a physical device known as the Blizzard Authenticator and as its own separate mobile app, Battle.net Mobile Authenticator.

The Battle.net Gift Cards, also known as Balance Cards and Blizzard Gift Cards from 2017-2021, are cards available at select retailers that can be purchased and redeemed for Battle.net Balance. They are sold at retailers as physical cards and can be bought as a digital code from online retailers. On 21 December 2015, the gift cards were made available in Europe. The original introduction of the gift cards was to allow friends and family to be able to gift Battle.net Balance to others. However, since 19 April 2018, the Battle.net Balance can now be gifted on the Battle.net platform itself.

The Battle of Traitor's Rest was a battle between the forces of the dracthyr Abereth (fighting for Sindragosa), the djaradin Gharrin, and the tuskarr Umtila against the mutant Doomshadow (fighting as proxy for Neltharion) at what would become Traitor's Rest in the Azure Span, told through The Story of Traitor's Rest.
The Battle of Go'Shek Farm was a conflict between the Mag'har Clans and the Kingdom of Stromgarde taking place in the Arathi Highlands just after the destruction of Dalaran.

Battle of Dazar'alor sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 8.1.0 and the Battle of Dazar'alor, the second raid of . They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Battle of Dazar'alor appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 23. Completing one of these sets will grant the Daz'aling Attire achievement.
